name: quiet_frequency
character: a 120 s action trailer judged on its own acts: a sound-design opening that is allowed to be the quietest and sparsest part of the cue, a chase that is allowed to be dense, loud and syncopated, one declared second of silence, a second peak louder than the first, and a last act that drops the music and ends unresolved; the engines, the radio and the device are written into the arrangement and judged with it.

focus.label: the cell on the horns
focus.reason: the cue is defined by a figure: four horns state it at each camera
